verdict.rationale: Twilio Video documents a server-side REST Rooms resource for setting room properties at creation, including name, type, max participants, max participant duration and a status-callback webhook. That shows a client-independent server API for sessions exists, but none of the story's specific operations are documented in the pack. Missing for 10: listing rooms/sessions, muting participants, removing/kicking participants, ending/completing a room via API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, a server-side API lets me list sessions, mute or remove participants, and end a session without a client in the loop

citations.quote: Use this API to set Room properties such as its name, type, TURN configuration, webhook status callback URL, and the maximum number of Participants.
This makes it easier to interact with Twilio's REST API without having to keep track of Twilio's Room SID identifiers.
The maximum number of seconds a Participant can be connected to the room.
